question: Two circles of radii 9 cm and 4 cm, respectively, touch each other externally at point A. PQ is the direct common tangent of those two circles of centres O₁ and O₂, respectively. The length of PQ is equal to:
solution:
Given:

The radii of both circles are 9 cm and 4 cm

Both circles touch each other at point A externally

PQ is the common tangent of both circles.

Calculations:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bac1d32bfade07ef074bcc877b6c79563f80bd2823caba6b424da1595303fb1.png] 

Length of a direct common tangent, when 2 circles are touching externally, 

⇒ √[d² - (R - r)²]

where D is the distance between 2 centres

R and r are 2 radii of circles

Calculation:

Using the formula, we get

⇒ √[132 - (9 - 4)²]

⇒ √144 = 12

∴ The length of PQ = 12 cm.
